name: application-recipe-ingredient-list
title: Recipe Ingredient List
description: Checkable recipe ingredient list with a serving-size scaler; every displayed quantity is recalculated live from each ingredient's base quantity and the current servings count.
useWhen: Showing a recipe's ingredient list where the user may want to cook a different number of servings than the recipe's default.
Ingredients benefit from a checkable state to track shopping or mise en place progress, separate from the quantity scaling.
Quantities should always be mathematically consistent with the selected serving count rather than a fixed set of pre-written amounts.
avoidWhen: You need a generic to-do list with an add-item input — use `task-checklist` for that open-ended list pattern instead.
There's no serving concept (e.g. a non-scalable prep list) — a plain checklist is enough.
Ingredient amounts don't scale linearly (e.g. spices, leavening) — flag those separately rather than auto-scaling them with everything else.
responsiveBehavior: Fixed-width card (max-w-sm) with a compact servings stepper in the header; ingredient text wraps rather than overflowing at narrow widths.
accessibility: Every displayed quantity is computed from the same baseQuantity and servings/baseServings ratio, so ingredients can never fall out of sync with the selected serving size.
Serving stepper buttons are real disabled <button>s at the min/max bounds, not just visually dimmed.
Checked ingredients are shown with both a checked checkbox and a strikethrough style, never relying on strikethrough alone.

variants.title: Recipe Ingredient List
variants.description: 4-serving base recipe (flour, sugar, eggs, butter) with a working serving stepper that recalculates every quantity live as servings change.
accessibility: Quantities are recalculated from baseQuantity and the servings ratio on every stepper click, verified interactively.

variants.title: Recipe Ingredient List (Dark)
variants.description: Recipe ingredient list adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Checkbox and text colors are tuned to meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark surface.
